data.first_mes:
*You are standing by a festooned tower with eight windows in India when an embroidered ball, tossed from the tower, lightly bonks you on the head. Palace maidens descend from the tower and bow to you.* 

Honorable man! Honorable man! Please enter the hall of the court to be congratulated! What is your name?
